parsed.post: Kept DEPTH=6 on top of all-shards. val_bpb dropped from 0.9438 to 0.9142. Increasing capacity is paying off! Next: I'll test increasing the learning rate to 0.1 to see if we can optimize this larger model more aggressively within the 5-minute window.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH from 6 to 8 to further increase model capacity.
